noninferiority.margin_status: User-specified after seeing existing 100-seed results; post-hoc sensitivity analysis, not preregistered confirmation or externally validated practical margin
noninferiority.estimand: Mean paired per-episode H_Dual-H_Single on the previous common pre-terminal exposure
noninferiority.method: One-sample t test of paired differences; one-sided 95% upper bound; 5000 paired-seed percentile bootstrap sensitivity
noninferiority.joint_claim: Both co-primary NI tests must reject (intersection-union); also report Bonferroni simultaneous one-sided 95% bounds
noninferiority.equivalence: Secondary paired TOST with symmetric bounds (-0.01,+0.01), each one-sided alpha=.05, equivalent to a 90% t CI contained in bounds

temporal.acceleration: Unquantized forward 1 s velocity increment; highD half-frame endpoints linearly interpolated; simulated endpoints use frozen exact observation interpolation
temporal.auxiliary: Instantaneous signed highD xAcceleration versus executed simulation held acceleration (respecting speed bounds), plus within-window centering sensitivity
temporal.eligibility: Same follower/leader and leader's preceding identity, same lanes, quiet lateral motion throughout full 6 s; both speeds 20..40, gap (0,115], abs(relative speed)<=20; complete endpoints; every sampled 1 s action within [-4,2] without clipping
temporal.simulation_matching: Intersection of identical follower/leader IDs and window starts passing in both arms, before their earlier collision
temporal.cross_correlation: Corr(a_front(t),a_rear(t+lag)); positive lag means rear measured later; negative lags retained as directional control
temporal.centering: Subtract each actor's mean of eleven forward-1s accelerations at 0,.5,...,5 s within its 6s window; sensitivity only, short-window demeaning can bias lag correlations
temporal.bootstrap: Whole recording for highD (10 blocks), paired episode seed for simulations (100 blocks); percentile 95% pointwise intervals, no independent-window or causal-response claim
temporal.interpretation: 0.5s lag overlaps the 1s measurement windows and simulation holds controls for 1s; do not infer reaction delay from that point. No lag-peak tuning or refitting.

scope: Diagnostic selected stable 6s common-pair windows. Positive lag does not identify causal reaction delay. Half-second overlapping measurement/held-action effects and highD trajectory smoothing must be considered.
